tour.name: Uttarakhand Himalaya
tour.text: My main study region. I map landslide, flood and glacial lake outburst hazards together with who is exposed and how vulnerable they are, across all 111 subdistricts.

tour.name: Garhwal Himalaya
tour.text: Landslide susceptibility for 58 subdistricts, tested against 3,484 recorded landslides. Published in Earth Systems and Environment, 2026.

tour.name: Kumaon Himalaya
tour.text: Does averaging hide danger? In 24 of 53 subdistricts, mean-based maps under-classified local landslide hotspots.

tour.name: Kedarnath, 2013
tour.text: Extreme rainfall and the breach of Chorabari Lake caused a devastating flood and debris flow, a reminder of how rain, ice and steep valleys combine.

tour.name: Chamoli, 2021
tour.text: An avalanche from Ronti Peak turned into a debris flow that destroyed two hydropower projects: a cascading hazard that single-hazard maps miss.

tour.name: South Lhonak, 2023
tour.text: A glacial lake outburst flood down the Teesta breached the Chungthang dam. Outbursts like this are the subject of my AGU26 talk on glacial lake susceptibility and downstream hazard.

tour.name: UNESCO, Paris
tour.text: With UNESCO's Disaster Risk Reduction Unit and the International Consortium on Landslides, I built an AI assistant that answers questions from the landslide literature with every source cited.
